content.short: Giza is an autonomous DeFi agent platform that continuously rebalances deposited funds.
content.description: Giza runs agents that manage deposited capital across DeFi positions, rebalancing as conditions change rather than on a fixed schedule. The pitch rests on the agent reacting faster than a person would, which is true, and on it reacting correctly, which is the part worth checking against a track record.
content.meta: Agents that rebalance deposited capital across DeFi as conditions change, not on a fixed schedule.
